title: Scenario 5: let the AP run at 5 gigabit
task: This is a 6300M with Smart Rate ports (1/1/1 to 1/1/24 do 100M to 5G). The AP on 1/1/1 can do 5 gigabit and the one on 1/1/2 can do 2.5, but both are linked at 1 gigabit. Find out why and fix it so each links at its best. The desk PC on 1/1/3 is a 1G device and stays that way.
hints: `show interface 1/1/1 physical` shows the speed the link runs at and what the port is configured to allow.
`speed auto` with nothing after it offers every speed the port can do. `no speed` does the same. `speed auto 1g` offers only 1G.
`speed 1000-full` is a fixed speed with auto-negotiation off: nothing faster is ever offered.
The speeds here are the hardware's. The Switch Simulator has virtual ports and hides `speed` entirely, so this part of the sandbox is modelled, not captured.
